metrics.name: CSOAI Public Benefit Statement
metrics.statement: CSOAI's independent signed measurement infrastructure provides permanent, verifiable audit trail for AI governance across UK public sector. Every measurement is Ed25519-signed, Bitcoin-anchored via OpenTimestamps, and verifiable by any stranger without an account. Corrections are published with same rigor (48 corrections to date, 1 retraction DR-0007). This eliminates the 'who audits the auditor' problem in AI governance.
